    for name in ['SelectedRoots.csproj','BenchProbe.cs','DotNetHost.csproj','DotNetHost.cs']:
        shutil.copy(bench+name,'/work/recipe/'+name)

    assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path('/work/out/DiffPlex.Benchmark.dll').read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '1da7fb72d688a9b346fdb52318d9683a2bd861bd4d09dcd3eca933c6da0368bb'
    run('precision',['python3','-c',"from pathlib import Path\nimport json\ntext=Path('/work/cilica/tools/CompatibilityCandidates/diffplex-benchmark/measure.py').read_text()\nexec(text.split('for work in [0,1]:')[0])\nrow=run('dotnet','measure',0,32768,label='-precision')\nassert all(x['checksum']==6146*32768 for x in row['records'] if 'sample' in x)\n(out/'precision-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(row,indent=2))\nprint(json.dumps(row,indent=2))\n"])
    save({'status':'passed','elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,'steps':steps})
except Exception as ex:
